timestamp_note: Timestamp units detected from numeric magnitude. Source header says ms, but sample values around 1.37 billion indicate Unix seconds.
source_identifier_note: source_file_id is a relative file path, not a confirmed VM ID.
financial_cost_note: No actual financial cost is present in these VMware performance files.
validation_note: Validated CPU and memory utilization excludes zero-capacity, negative and above-capacity samples. Raw measurements are retained separately.
